# Aurum Invoice Studio

> Invoice, receipt and quotation app for Nigerian businesses. Pay once, no monthly fees. Works on a phone, even without data. Clients receive a private, wax-sealed link and the owner sees when it is opened.

Aurum is an invoicing app, not accounting software: it does not run payroll, track stock or file taxes.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/): what Aurum is and pricing
- [About and contact](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/about/): how buying works, refunds, WhatsApp contact
- [Reviews](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/reviews/): customer reviews
- [Invoice app for Nigerian businesses](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/invoice-app-nigeria/): Make invoices, receipts and quotations on your phone, with your logo and bank details. Your clients open them as an experience. Pay once, no monthly fees.
- [Receipt maker for Nigerian businesses](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/receipt-maker-nigeria/): Make professional payment receipts on your phone in one tap, with your logo and a Paid stamp. Turn any paid invoice into a receipt. Pay once.
- [Quotation maker for Nigerian businesses](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/quotation-maker-nigeria/): Make professional price quotations on your phone with a valid-until date and deposit. When accepted, turn it into an invoice in one tap. Pay once.
- [Send invoices on WhatsApp with a private link](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/whatsapp-invoice/): Stop typing prices in WhatsApp chats. Send a private, wax-sealed invoice link, see when it is opened and remind clients in one tap. Pay once.

- [Invoice template for Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-template-nigeria/): A simple invoice template you can copy for your Nigerian business, with every field explained, plus tips to make it look professional.
- [Receipt template for Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/receipt-template-nigeria/): A simple payment receipt template for Nigerian businesses, what a receipt must show, and how it differs from an invoice.
- [Quotation template for Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/quotation-template-nigeria/): How to write a price quotation in Nigeria, a copyable template, and how to turn an accepted quote into an invoice.
- [Invoice vs receipt vs quotation](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-vs-receipt-vs-quotation/): Invoice, receipt, quotation, proforma and delivery note explained in plain language, with when to use each one in your business.
- [Proforma invoice in Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/proforma-invoice-nigeria/): What a proforma invoice is, when to use one in Nigeria, how it differs from a normal invoice, and a template you can copy.

- [How to get paid on time](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/how-to-get-paid-on-time-nigeria/): Practical ways Nigerian small businesses can stop chasing money: deposits, clear invoices, due dates, easy payment and polite follow-up.
- [Invoicing for Instagram and WhatsApp sellers](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoicing-for-instagram-whatsapp-vendors/): How online sellers in Nigeria can look professional, avoid payment disputes and build trust: invoices, receipts and order confirmations.
- [VAT on invoices in Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/vat-on-invoices-nigeria/): How to show VAT on an invoice in Nigeria: the basics, a worked example at 7.5%, and when to ask an accountant.
- [Deposits and part payments on invoices](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/deposit-and-part-payment-invoice/): How to take a deposit, invoice the balance and issue receipts for part payments, with a clear example for Nigerian businesses.
- [Delivery note vs invoice](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/delivery-note-vs-invoice/): What a delivery note is, how it differs from an invoice, when to use each one, and what to include. Simple guide for Nigerian businesses.
- [How to send an invoice on WhatsApp](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/how-to-send-an-invoice-on-whatsapp/): The best ways to send an invoice on WhatsApp in Nigeria: PDF, image or private link, with a message template and mistakes to avoid.
- [Credit note explained](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/credit-note-nigeria/): A credit note reduces what a customer owes, for returns, mistakes or discounts. How it works, what to include and an example.
- [Purchase order explained](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/purchase-order-explained/): What a purchase order is, who sends it, how it differs from an invoice, and what to include. Plain guide for Nigerian small businesses.
- [Best invoice app for small businesses in Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/best-invoice-app-for-small-business-nigeria/): How to choose an invoice app in Nigeria: 8 things to check, the main types compared, and where each one fits a small business.
- [Invoice for photographers in Nigeria](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-photographers-nigeria/): How a photographer in Nigeria should invoice: coverage, extra hours, editing, prints, usage rights and deposits, with a sample invoice.
- [Invoice for caterers and event planners](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-caterers-and-event-planners-nigeria/): How caterers and event planners in Nigeria should invoice: per-head pricing, deposits, extras, cancellation terms and a sample invoice.
- [Invoice for fashion designers and tailors](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-fashion-designers-and-tailors-nigeria/): How fashion designers and tailors in Nigeria should invoice: bespoke pricing, fabric, deposits, fittings, aso-ebi orders and a sample invoice.
- [Invoice for makeup artists and beauty businesses](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-makeup-artists-and-beauty-businesses-nigeria/): How makeup artists, hair stylists and beauty businesses in Nigeria should invoice: bridal packages, trials, travel fees, deposits and a sample invoice.
- [Invoice for freelancers and consultants](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-freelancers-and-consultants-nigeria/): How freelancers and consultants in Nigeria should invoice: hourly or project pricing, milestones, retainers and late payment, with a sample invoice.
- [Invoice for graphic designers and creatives](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-graphic-designers-and-creatives-nigeria/): How graphic designers, video editors and creatives in Nigeria should invoice: scope, revisions, file ownership and deposits, with a sample invoice.
- [Invoice for contractors and artisans](https://auruminvoicestudio.netlify.app/guides/invoice-for-contractors-and-artisans-nigeria/): How contractors, builders, electricians and other artisans in Nigeria should invoice: labour, materials, stage payments and a sample invoice.
